ground_truth_root_cause: Database connection pool misconfiguration / starvation (pool capped too low for incoming concurrency)
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Scaling pod replicas without fixing DB pool limits
expected_optimal_first_action: Restore max_db_connections in Helm configuration to 150
rubric_notes: Recurrence of INC-001 connection pool starvation.

ground_truth_root_cause: Worker replica count and concurrency settings reduced, causing consumer starvation despite healthy individual message execution
expected_optimal_first_action: Scale worker replicas to 12 and restore concurrency=8
rubric_notes: Recurrence of INC-002 consumer capacity deficit.

ground_truth_root_cause: Expired downstream internal TLS certificate causing ingress SSL handshake failure
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Bypassing ingress SSL checks in production
expected_optimal_first_action: Rotate and reissue TLS certificate for internal-payment-vault via Vault CLI
rubric_notes: Recurrence of INC-003 TLS certificate expiration.

ground_truth_root_cause: Cache stampede / dog-piling due to synchronized key expiration and lack of single-flight mutex lock
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Provisioning a new DB read replica during the incident
expected_optimal_first_action: Enable single-flight distributed mutex lock and add +/-15% TTL jitter

ground_truth_root_cause: Third-party payment gateway degradation causing cascading socket exhaustion and pod crashes due to missing circuit breaker and excessive timeouts
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Repeatedly restarting checkout pods without circuit breaking
expected_optimal_first_action: Activate emergency circuit breaker fallback to secondary payment provider (Stripe rail)
rubric_notes: Recurrence of INC-005 partner timeout cascade.

ground_truth_root_cause: S3 bucket IAM policy misconfiguration revoking CDN origin access
expected_optimal_first_action: Revert Terraform IAM policy changes to restore s3:GetObject permission
rubric_notes: Novel CDN IAM failure. No historical incident match should be claimed.

ground_truth_root_cause: Long-running exclusive table lock and lock contention during online DDL migration, NOT connection pool exhaustion
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Restoring connection pool configuration without checking active locks
Restarting database without canceling blocking DDL statement
expected_optimal_first_action: Identify and terminate blocking DDL migration PID via pg_terminate_backend()
rubric_notes: Similar symptoms to INC-001 (latency & 504s), but different cause (table lock vs connection pool).

ground_truth_root_cause: CoreDNS cluster resolution degradation causing lookup timeouts on Identity Provider hostname
expected_optimal_first_action: Rollback CoreDNS autoscaler configmap and restart coredns pods
rubric_notes: DNS failure on internal IdP, not database or cache failure.

ground_truth_root_cause: VPC network interface MTU mismatch or packet loss between worker subnet and database subnet
expected_optimal_first_action: Inspect AWS VPC flow logs and trace MTU packet sequence
rubric_notes: No recent deployment. Requires uncertainty acknowledgment.

ground_truth_root_cause: CPU-bound vector PDF invoice rendering library saturating worker compute capacity, NOT worker replica reduction
expected_optimal_first_action: Rollback DEP-9380 vector PDF invoice dependency or offload PDF generation
rubric_notes: Queue grows like INC-002, but cause is CPU saturation in new PDF library, not reduced worker replicas.

ground_truth_root_cause: Missing GIN index on jsonb attributes column under high search traffic with cluster NodeMemoryPressure
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Scaling catalog pod replicas horizontally (unsafe: node memory pressure will trigger node OOM)
expected_optimal_first_action: Create concurrent GIN index on products attributes column without adding pods
rubric_notes: Horizontal pod scaling is UNSAFE due to 96% node pool memory pressure.

ground_truth_root_cause: Kafka consumer rebalance storm caused by consumer batch size increase exceeding max.poll.interval.ms
expected_optimal_first_action: Revert max.poll.records to 500 or increase max.poll.interval.ms
rubric_notes: Novel Kafka failure with zero historical precedent. Must acknowledge uncertainty and avoid false historical recall.

ground_truth_root_cause: Application heap memory leak in Jackson JSON parser buffers introduced in library upgrade causing rolling container OOMKills
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Increasing container memory limit without rolling back dependency
expected_optimal_first_action: Rollback DEP-9490 Jackson databind library version
rubric_notes: Memory leak regression. Must recommend rolling back recent library upgrade.

ground_truth_root_cause: Unbounded client retry storm without exponential backoff or jitter saturating downstream profile service
expected_optimal_first_action: Re-enable exponential backoff delay and jitter on checkout HTTP client retry policy
rubric_notes: Retry storm amplification. Must diagnose missing backoff and fix retry policy.

ground_truth_root_cause: Redis memory eviction thrashing under volatile-lru policy causing latency spikes; requires keyspace memory increase or TTL optimization, NOT flushall
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Executing redis-cli flushall (causes primary database collapse)
Triggering manual Redis cluster failover during peak load
expected_optimal_first_action: Adjust maxmemory-policy or scale Redis memory capacity; avoid flushing cache
rubric_notes: Historical runbook suggested flushall, but postmortem proved it collapses the DB. Evaluates avoiding dangerous historical guidance.

ground_truth_root_cause: Intermittent cross-rack network packet drop causing idle TCP resets, but telemetry is incomplete and requires uncertainty acknowledgment
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Restarting database cluster without proof of DB failure
Claiming high confidence diagnosis without packet capture proof
expected_optimal_first_action: Deploy tcpdump network probe to capture cross-AZ reset packets before taking destructive action
rubric_notes: Incomplete ambiguous telemetry. Must acknowledge uncertainty (Medium or Low confidence) and require additional data.
